skills.name: Interface contract
skills.description: Resolve interface names, scope, and entry points from requirements.
skills.trigger: Ambiguous names, action scope, or requirement versus evaluator assumptions.

skills.name: Ready navigation
skills.description: Use supplied navigation modules with prepared state and synchronous rendering.
skills.trigger: Initial render or navigation depends on state that arrives too late.

skills.name: State roundtrip
skills.description: Trace save decoding, store updates, and reopen consistency.
skills.trigger: Saved values become stale when reopened or refreshed.
